answer: Operator-Linked Liability Ledger. Each new identity must route its first transactions through a distinct funding path; the system flags any cluster sharing an upstream source, like light splitting through a prism into shared origins. Every flagged cluster ties to one accountable operator record, which accrues a saffron penalty balance—a withheld fee that grows per redundant identity. Operators must post a nectar deposit covering the penalty ceiling before activating identities; sybils drain that single deposit.
